tagline: One of the world's largest global alternative asset management firms
hero_kpi_rationale: Fee-earning AUM is the primary driver of recurring and predictable revenues for Carlyle, reflecting the underlying base on which management fees are earned. It is a key indicator of the structural health of the business model, particularly in the context of asset manager valuations.

kpis.name: Fee-earning AUM
kpis.explanation: Amount of assets for which Carlyle earns management fees.
kpis.description: Total fee-generating assets in 2025, broken down by segments Private Equity ($101.4B), Credit ($169.5B), and AlpInvest ($66.0B).

kpis.name: Total AUM
kpis.explanation: Total value of assets managed by Carlyle for its funds and clients.
kpis.description: Total AUM of $476.8 billion as of December 31, 2025, distributed across Private Equity ($163.5B), Credit ($211.3B), and AlpInvest ($102.0B).
kpis.signal: Significant scale in the private markets

kpis.name: Gross IRR
kpis.explanation: Annualized return generated by funds before fees and carried interest.
kpis.description: Average gross IRR of Global Credit Carry funds at 11% across the portfolio. Historical performance indicator, not forward-looking.
kpis.signal: Historical performance of Global Credit Carry funds

kpis.name: MOIC
kpis.explanation: Total value generated relative to invested capital in funds.
kpis.description: MOIC of 1.3x for all Global Credit Carry funds, indicating a 30% return on invested capital.

kpis.name: Net Accrued Carry
kpis.explanation: Portion of fund profits earned by Carlyle as manager.
kpis.description: Net accrued carried interest of $263 million for Global Credit Carry funds, reflecting realized performance not yet distributed.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Number of employees employed by the company.
kpis.description: Approximately 2,300 employees globally, representing the firm's management and advisory capacity.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €29.12B in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €13.89B in the latest year

kpis.name: AI Capex Growth
kpis.explanation: Annualized growth rate of capital expenditures related to artificial intelligence, particularly in data centers and technology infrastructure.
kpis.description: Annualized growth of 30% in portfolio technology spending, primarily driven by investments in AI and data centers. Proprietary portfolio data as of December 31, 2025.

kpis.name: Data Center Shipments
kpis.explanation: Growth ratio of data center hardware shipment volumes compared to 2021.
kpis.description: Data center hardware shipments are 7.5 times higher than in 2021, supported by the wave of investments in generative AI and cloud infrastructure. Source: public data and Carlyle portfolio analysis.

risks.title: Subjective asset valuations and potential errors
risks.summary: The fair value assessment of certain assets relies on subjective judgments, which may lead to errors in fund valuations and performance allocations.
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in Item 1A, the language is direct about subjective judgments and potential valuation errors. This risk directly impacts reported fund performance and performance allocations (carry). (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Impairment of equity method investments
risks.summary: Investments accounted for under the equity method are subject to impairment if their carrying value is no longer recoverable, affecting earnings and shareholders' equity.
risks.score_rationale: Item 1A details the risk of impairment of equity method investments, notably the investment in NGP which experienced a significant write-down. Fundraising challenges and changes in economic arrangements are key impairment factors. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Market volatility impacting performance allocations
risks.summary: Significant fluctuations in the fair value of fund assets can materially affect performance allocation revenues, which are a key and volatile revenue source.
risks.score_rationale: Item 1A highlights the significant impact of fair value changes on performance allocations (carry). Portfolio volatility can generate multi-billion dollar swings in performance revenues. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Foreign exchange risk on foreign assets and revenues
risks.summary: Changes in exchange rates can reduce management fees and performance allocations denominated in foreign currencies, affecting consolidated results.
risks.score_rationale: Item 1A quantifies the impact of a 10% depreciation of foreign currencies on management fees and performance allocations. Significant international exposure makes this risk material, though less existential than others. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Interest rate risk on variable-rate borrowings
risks.summary: Variable-rate debt exposes the company to higher interest expenses if rates rise, impacting net income and free cash flow.
risks.score_rationale: Item 1A mentions variable-rate obligations under CLOs and quantifies the impact of a 1% increase in interest rates. The estimated financial impact is moderate, and exposure is managed through balance sheet structure. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Credit risk related to derivative counterparties
risks.summary: The risk that counterparties to derivative instruments or financial institutions fail to meet their obligations may result in direct financial losses.
risks.score_rationale: Item 1A identifies credit risk from derivative counterparties and financial institutions. The company seeks to minimize this risk by limiting exposure per counterparty and using netting agreements. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Impairment of intangible assets and goodwill
risks.summary: Intangible assets and goodwill are subject to impairment if economic conditions or the performance of acquired entities deteriorate, affecting the book value of shareholders' equity.
risks.score_rationale: Item 1A provides detailed discussion on the assessment of intangible assets and goodwill, requiring significant judgments and estimates. The risk of impairment is clearly stated, with annual reviews and ad hoc tests required. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: While Carlyle does not position AI as a centralized internal strategy, the firm identifies significant investment opportunities linked to AI. The company emphasizes that its portfolio investments benefit from the exponential growth in AI spending (notably data centers at +30% annualized) and acknowledges the transformative impact of generative AI across investment sectors.
evidence: Technology spending growth at record 30% annualized rate driven by AI-related investment
Data center hardware shipments 7.5x higher than 2021 levels
Concerns regarding AI bubble intensified in November 2025; software sector down 33% YTD 2026
Concentration of AI capex particularly in data center infrastructure and AI product offerings
